Style: cinematic - realistic

A woman with a mechanical arm in armor slowly turns her head and torso to face the front, then begins to steadily walk toward the camera. A character on the right moves in sync with her, slightly lagging behind and positioned to the side. The two move synchronously, their steps aligned, occasionally glancing at each other and communicating with gestures, as if engaged in conversation. The background characters remain distant, their bodies subtly swaying but staying in place. Glowing green mushrooms flicker gently, and sparks from a nearby campfire rise realistically. Smoke continuously flows through the scene. The camera smoothly follows backward, consistently keeping the central characters in sharp focus. The mechanical arm swings with mechanical precision, and the armor plates shift realistically with each step, while facial features remain consistent. Firelight and ambient light create a coherent, dynamic illumination across all objects. The armored woman says, "We must be prepared... to fight. The UFOs are coming soon."

Use>>> The woman say "<Transcript1>"

in your text prompt for whatever you want the character to say. 

It will refer to the audio vocals.
And Link up "text_transcript" to the replace field in Replace node.

电影跟拍镜头。前景中，一位拥有机械臂的装甲性感女战士缓缓将头和躯干转向正前方，然后开始稳步朝镜头走来。右侧的角色与他步伐一致，稍稍落后并位于侧方。

两人同步移动，步调一致，不时微微转头并用手势交流，仿佛正在交谈。他们的姿态与节奏透露出一种随意而目标明确的动势。

背景中的角色们保持在远处，身体自然地微微晃动，但始终待在原位。发光的绿色蘑菇轻轻明灭，附近篝火升起的火星以符合真实物理的方式飘散而上。环境烟雾持续地在画面中流动。

镜头平稳地向后跟移，始终将中心角色置于清晰对焦之中。机械臂以机械般的精准度摆动，铠甲的甲片随着每一步都真实地移位，面部特征则始终保持一致。火光与环境光在所有对象身上创造出连贯、动态的光照效果。
